notes: Checked by hand only. I have no shell here, so the plan checker (bun tools/plan/cli.ts) has not been run on these stops. Latch or Aster should run it before anyone accepts the candidate.

T1, in line order along the trunk: Comet Row at z -688, Records at -385, Crown Circus at -78. Gaps are 303 m and 307 m (rule: 300–500). All 30 m platforms are on straight trunk. Circus (-93 to -63) stays clear of the loop join at -56. Records (-400 to -370) stays clear of Market Street. Comet (-703 to -673) stays clear of Comet Row.

S1, west to east: Gardens x -160, Crown Circus 90, Harbour 290, Skyport 530. Gaps are 250, 200 and 240 m (rule: 200–500). All 50 m platforms are on the straight trunk; Skyport ends at x 555, short of the loop at 560. Gardens stays on the Records Axis (x -160). Skyport fronts the pier because it stands over the water.
Interchange: T1/circus (0,-78) and S1/circus (90,0) are 119 m apart, inside the 150 m limit. The two lines join at this one pair, so the network is connected (N-C1).

Every entrance fronts a road or foot path whose centreline is under 6 m away: the Boulevard, the Circus Road median, the Crown Parade mall and the Skyport Pier. All of it is walkable public space (W-2/W-3).

N-R1 fails, and no stop position on these lines can fix it. Best case for four plots: harbour-east 268 m, rocket-west 275, lantern-west 288, docks-east 291 (limit 250). Tram spacing (at least 300 m) and the interchange (circus stop no further south than about -150) leave no better positions.

Positions chosen for tight reach: the Gardens station keeps crown-terraces at 247 m. The S1 circus station at x 90 keeps crescent-north at 247 m and leaves Harbour at x 290 exactly 200 m away. All other plots are inside 222 m.
